Metadata.title: Le Revenu Community
Metadata.description: Ask your money questions, share your experience and talk with the Le Revenu newsroom.
Metadata.discussionsDescription: All discussions of the Le Revenu readers' community.

Discussions.title: Discussions
Discussions.intro: Ask your money questions, share your experience and talk with the newsroom.
Discussions.replyCount: {count, plural, =0 {No replies} one {# reply} other {# replies}}
Discussions.emptyHint: Start the first discussion in this space.
Discussions.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No discussions} one {# discussion} other {# discussions}}

DiscussionNew.title: New post
DiscussionNew.intro: A question or an experience for the community of Le Revenu readers.
DiscussionNew.typeHint_question: Get help from members and the newsroom.
DiscussionNew.typeHint_discussion: Share an experience, an opinion, a piece of news.
DiscussionNew.titleHint: 10 to 150 characters. A clear title, phrased as a question, gets answers faster.
DiscussionNew.titlePlaceholder: E.g.: Should I open a PER at 45?
DiscussionNew.contentPlaceholder: Your situation, what you have already considered… The more context, the better the answers.
DiscussionNew.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, your text is kept.
DiscussionNew.tip1: A title that says it all: “PEA or CTO for a first ETF?” rather than “ETF question”.
DiscussionNew.tip2: Give context: amount, horizon, what you have already considered.
DiscussionNew.tip3: Share your experience, no personal advice and no solicitation.

Replies.title: Replies
Replies.emptyHint: Be the first to help {name}: your experience counts, even partial.
Replies.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, your text is kept.
Replies.ctaTitle: Have an opinion or an experience to share?
Replies.ctaText: Sign in to reply to {name}. You will come back here afterwards.

Auth.loginIntro: Back to the Le Revenu readers' community.
Auth.registerIntro: Free. Ask your questions, share your experience, talk with the newsroom.
Auth.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore. It is the name shown on your posts.
Auth.noAccount: No account yet? <link>Create a free account</link>
Auth.legal: By creating an account you accept the <link>community charter</link>.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts, try again in a minute.
Auth.genericError: Something went wrong, try again in a moment.
Auth.googleTaken: An account already exists with this email. Sign in with your password.
Auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {email}, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
Auth.forgotSentHint: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder, then try again in a few minutes.
Auth.resetIntro: Choose a new password. At least 8 characters.
Auth.resetInvalidIntro: This link was already used or is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
Auth.verifyIntroShort: Your account is created, your address still needs confirming.
Auth.verifyIntro: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.
Auth.resent: Link sent again. Check your spam folder too.
Auth.confirmedBanner: Address confirmed. You can sign in.
Auth.notConfirmed: Your address is not confirmed yet.

Errors.title: Something went wrong
Errors.description: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact us.
Errors.notFoundTitle: This page does not exist, or not anymore.
Errors.notFoundDescription: The link may be wrong, or the discussion was removed. The community is still here.
Errors.serverTitle: Something went wrong on our side.
Errors.serverDescription: Not your fault. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, tell us with the code below.

codes.rateLimited: Too many requests, try again in a minute.
codes.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
codes.generic: Something went wrong, try again in a moment.

Space.label: This space
Space.allDescription: Eleven thematic spaces, mirroring the main sections of Le Revenu. Pick one to filter the discussions.

Form.usernamePattern: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.
Form.alreadyTaken: This email or username is already taken.
Form.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Form.passwordSame: The new password must differ from the current one.
Form.categoryUnknown: This space no longer exists, choose another one.

Account.title: My account
Account.displayNameHint: Optional, 2 to 60 characters. This is what others see.
Account.emailHint: changing the address will come in a later version.
Account.deleteIntro: Deleting your account erases your personal information. Your discussions and replies stay, signed “Deleted account”.
Account.deleteConfirmHint: Type {username} to confirm. This cannot be undone.
Account.setPasswordIntro: You sign in with Google. Add a password to also sign in with your email. Both will work.
Account.passwordSet: Password set. You can now sign in with Google or with your email.
